_comment: Le Truc locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[play]', '[raise]', '[accept]', '[fold]'), the card labels/suits (e.g. 3♠, A♥, K♦), player labels (P0, P1), or numeric point amounts.

_slots.{winner}: The player number who won the trick
_slots.{points}: A hand point value, e.g. 1 or 2
_slots.{cards}: A space-separated list of the player's card labels, e.g. 'A♦ 3♠ A♥'

player_prompt.intro: a summary of the game rules

board.new_hand:
### New hand worth {points} pt(s)
Your cards: {cards}

invalid_move.wrong_rank: You don't hold that rank (suits ignored in input).

action.raise: P{pid} raises - hand now {points} pts. Opponent must '[accept]' or '[fold]'.
